  -- Result: The main course identified as missing was "shrimp and grits."

- Agent: Verification_Expert
  -- Action: Verify the comparison results to ensure accuracy.
  -- Observation: The main course "shrimp and grits" was confirmed to be missing in April.
  -- Thought: The verification confirmed the accuracy of the identified main course.
  -- Result: The final identified main course was "shrimp and grits."
